text:
Anya Patel: quick sanity-check — should we move the initial fairness shaping out to the edge proxy (ingress) or keep it centralized in admission?
Devin Cho: what do you mean by 'initial shaping'? ingress-level burst smoothing vs final quota check?
Anya Patel: yeah, something like a cheap fast smoothing at the edge to clamp huge spikes before they hit central quota. keeps backend cheaper.
Morgan Li: I like the idea but worried about correctness for multi-region tenants. edge might see different load patterns.
Liam O'Rourke: also telemetry gets weird. if edge drops/soft-rejects, central doesn't see full picture for abuse signals.
Tara Nguyen: tradeoff: cost + latency vs signal fidelity. We can do a conservative edge clamp (non-destructive) that only tags requests and only enforces after central verdict.
Anya Patel: idea: edge applies a token-bucket-like smoothing that emits a header X-Edge-Shaper: allowed/soft-throttle. central admission interprets it as advisory.
Devin Cho: that could work. simplified PD: edge keeps a per-tenant leaky-bucket with short window (1s) and a burst cap. central has authoritative quota & abuse score.
Morgan Li: curious about re-entrancy & retries. If edge soft-throttles and client retries to other region, we could amplify. need global de-dup or sticky balancing.
Liam O'Rourke: yep. we should include a short-lived global token in the path: if client retries within 10s include original shard id so central can correlate. messy but doable.
Tara Nguyen: proto config sketch (edge):
```
edge_shaper:
  window_ms: 1000
  burst_tokens: 50
  smoothing: true
  advisory_header: X-Edge-Shaper
```
central_admission will read header and add bias to admission score.
sre-bot: FYI — previous experiment (2024-09) with edge clamps reduced backend p95 by ~18% but increased cross-region retries by ~6%. Links: https://dash.internal/edge-shaper-exp
Devin Cho: ok that metric set is helpful. we need a guardrail: edge should never silently reject requests without central fallback. Always return soft-throttle (503+Retry-After?) only if central is unreachable.
Anya Patel: agreed. Enforcement modes: 
- advisory-only (default)
- soft-throttle (edge returns 429 but includes central-rollback token)
- hard-throttle (edge rejects when central explicitly asked to shed)

Morgan Li: for abuse detection, central needs raw counters. So edge must forward sampled raw counts (or aggregated deltas) and not absorb them entirely.
Liam O'Rourke: on impl boundary: making edge stateless helps scale, but we need per-tenant counters. Suggest local in-memory + periodic sync to central aggregator (1s resolution). 
Tara Nguyen: sync opts: push vs pull. push is simpler — edge pushes per-tenant delta every 1s. central ingestor handles spikes. For huge tenant cardinality we can fall back to only sampling heavy hitters.
Anya Patel: another corner: quotas vs fairness weights. If edge clamps by raw tokens, we may unfairly hit low-latency tenants. We should weight by tenant priority header.
Devin Cho: yep add header X-Tenant-Priority (0-100) — edge shaper scales burst_tokens *= priority_factor. doc: priority_factor = 0.5 + priority/200.
Morgan Li: ops ask: how to roll this out safely? feature flag + canary in single region + metric watch for retries and p95.
Liam O'Rourke: add kill-switch at infra level. if central backlog grows > X, automatically switch edge to advisory-only and route to central admission only.
Tara Nguyen: test plan: unit tests for header plumbing, integration with central admission sim, chaos test with region failover, and perf test for 100k tenants with sampling.
Anya Patel: next steps: prototype edge shim + central interpreter; I'll put up a short RFC with interfaces (edge->header format, push delta proto). anyone want to help on the prototype?
Devin Cho: I can take edge shim, 2-week spike.
Morgan Li: I'll own central ingestion changes.
Liam O'Rourke: I'll set up the canary infra and metric dashboards.
Tara Nguyen: I'll write the rollout + kill-switch playbook and tests.
sre-bot: Scheduled: canary dashboard template created -> https://dash.internal/templates/edge-shaper-canary
Anya Patel: awesome — I'll open the RFC and tag everyone. thanks. :thumbsup:
